Located in the heart of Austin, Barton Springs Pool is one of the most iconic spots to cool off at during the summer. Barton Springs Pool has been one of the most popular summer gathering spots for Austinites for more than 90 years. It spans a massive 3 acres in size and is located within Zilker Park, right in the heart of the city. The water is so refreshing and there’s plenty of green space surrounding to relax and soak in the sun! The scene at Barton Springs during a busy summer day looks like something out of a movie! It’s truly such a special place in Texas and a must-visit for a classic Austin experience. there is a dangerous amoeba in the water that will travel up your peehole and eat you inside out.

title: Discover Austin’s Best Natural Pools and Swimming Holes | [Production] Waterloo Realty
content: # Discover Austin’s Best Natural Pools and Swimming Holes. The area’s natural beauty, especially its stunning natural pools and swimming holes, is equally captivating. Whether you’re a local looking for a refreshing escape or a visitor seeking a unique experience, these top spots in and around Austin offer the perfect place to cool off and connect with nature. ## Barton Springs Pool. Barton Springs Pool is an iconic destination in the heart of Austin. Surrounded by the lush Zilker Park, it’s the perfect spot for swimming, sunbathing, and people-watching. Just a short drive from Austin, Hamilton Pool Preserve in Dripping Springs is a must-visit. This natural pool, created by the collapse of an underground river thousands of years ago, features a stunning waterfall cascading into a turquoise pool. As the oldest swimming pool in Texas, Deep Eddy Pool offers both history and a cool respite from the heat. Located in Wimberley, Jacob’s Well is one of Texas’s most famous natural swimming holes.
